purpose: dāna to a Brahmin at an Upākarma ceremony
notes: The Newari text records a gift of the Guhyeśvarīsahasranāma to a Brahmin (śrībrāhmayāta dānaviyā juro) on the occasion of the Upākarma of Muni (śrīmūṇiyā upākarmmasā) by the son of Sirahma (śrī sirahmakāyana). 'Sirahma' is likely a metathesis or colloquial spelling for Sīharāma/Siṃharāma, and 'kāyana' is the Newari ergative 'by the son'. The recipient 'śrībrāhma yāta' refers to a Brahmin generically and is not included as an individual person.
